chunks.title: Terraform Local Docker Provider Pattern
chunks.content:
Terraform Local Docker Provider Pattern

Minimal Terraform configuration for a local Docker-based workload. Requires Terraform >= 1.5.0. Uses kreuzwerker/docker provider ~> 3.0. Accepts build_context string variable. Outputs a container_name placeholder.

Decision rules:
- Use for local development and testing environments managed via Terraform + Docker
- Pin kreuzwerker/docker provider to ~> 3.0 for compatibility and stability

Trade-offs:
- Local state only — not suitable for team collaboration without a remote backend (S3 + DynamoDB)
- Docker provider may not be available in all CI environments

Anti-patterns:
- Do not use this pattern for production workloads — use AWS ECS, EKS, or equivalent
- Do not omit required_version — version constraints prevent accidental upgrades
